interest: This document illustrates the administrative cross-referencing and filing practices of the Department of State regarding commercial and regulatory inquiries initiated by members of Congress. It specifically reflects Congressional interest—from Massachusetts Representative George Holden Tinkham—in Japanese domestic fire insurance laws and documentation during the interwar period. Additionally, it highlights how State Department record keepers routed and cross-indexed economic despatches between country-specific decimal files (894.5061) and general decimal classifications (800.5061).
overview: This file consists of a single Department of State List of Papers sheet (Form DS-46) under decimal classification 894.5061, concerning fire insurance in Japan. It indexes document sub-number 8, representing Despatch No. 574 of February 3, 1933, from Arthur Garrels in Tokyo, which transmitted blank forms and regulatory information on Japanese fire insurance for delivery to Congressman George Holden Tinkham. The entry notes the attachment of a copy of the despatch and provides a cross-reference directing researchers to general file 800.5061/15 939.

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers entry recording a 1933 despatch from Tokyo transmitting Japanese fire insurance regulations and blank forms for Congressman George Holden Tinkham.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State List of Papers docket sheet (Form DS-46) records document sub-number 8 under decimal classification 894.5061, regarding fire insurance in Japan. It summarizes Despatch No. 574 sent from Tokyo by Garrels on February 3, 1933, which transmitted Japanese fire insurance regulations and related blank forms intended for Congressman George Holden Tinkham. The entry notes that a copy of the despatch was attached and cross-references general file 800.5061/15 939.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Fire Insurance—Japan
